label: Instagram DM
terms_note: Instagram professional (Business / Creator) accounts only. Two flavours: Instagram Login — POST graph.instagram.com/{IG_ID}/messages with an Instagram User token + instagram_business_basic + instagram_business_manage_messages; Facebook Login — POST /{PAGE_ID}/messages or /me/messages with a Page token (MESSAGE task) + instagram_manage_messages, Page linked to the IG account. 24 hours to respond to a user's message; human-agent tag (approval required) extends to 7 days. 'Businesses cannot start conversations; customers must message first'; no group messaging; Requests-folder threads inactive 30 days are not returned. Standard Access only reaches people with a role on the app — Advanced Access (App Review) for other people's accounts. Types: text ≤1,000 chars, links, images PNG/JPEG ≤8 MB (≤10 per message), video ≤25 MB, audio ≤25 MB, PDFs ≤25 MB, stickers, reactions, templates (generic / button / product), owned posts (MEDIA_SHARE), replies to specific messages. One-time Notifications, News Messaging and Sponsored Messages are NOT available on Instagram. Caution (docs read 2026-09-24): 'Apps with Standard Access can only send messages to people that have a role on the app' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/instagram/features/send-message) and for Instagram conversations 'Your app must be owned by a verified business' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations) - Advanced Access needs Meta App Review plus business verification.

sdks: Meta Graph API — plain HTTPS (graph.instagram.com or graph.facebook.com)

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.endpoint: Webhook `messages` field on the IG account; backfill GET /{ig-user-id}/conversations?platform=instagram

endpoints.call: message{attachment{type: like_heart}}` · reaction `{sender_action: react, payload{message_id, reaction: love}}` · reply to a specific message

endpoints.purpose: mark_seen}` · quick replies · templates (generic, button, product) · ice breakers · persistent menu

endpoints.notes: Requests-folder threads inactive 30 days are not returned

reference.limits: - Types: text ≤ 1,000 chars, links, images PNG / JPEG ≤ 8 MB (≤ 10 per message), video MP4 / OGG / AVI / MOV / WebM ≤ 25 MB, audio AAC / M4A / WAV / MP4 ≤ 25 MB, PDFs ≤ 25 MB, stickers, reactions, MEDIA_SHARE of owned posts. - No group messaging; no business-initiated conversations; One-time Notifications, News Messaging and Sponsored Messages are NOT available on Instagram. Rate limits described as "standard API rate limiting" (no numbers on the pages read).

fields.name: page_access_token
fields.help: Page access token of the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional account, requested by a person who can perform the MESSAGE task on that Page, with instagram_basic, instagram_manage_messages and pages_manage_metadata (Messenger Platform > Instagram Messaging, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/instagram/features/send-message); sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

config_fields.name: page_id
config_fields.help: Numeric id of the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional account; conversations are listed with /<page_id>/conversations?platform=instagram and messages sent with /<page_id>/messages. Env: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_DM_PAGE_ID.

me.note: GET /{page_id}?fields=id,name,instagram_business_account: the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional account and the linked IG account id.

list_inbound.note: GET /{page_id}/conversations?platform=instagram with field expansion messages.limit(1){...}: one row per conversation carrying its most recent message (which may be the Page's own outbound message - compare from_id with the Page / account id). thread_id is the conversation id for get_thread; from_id is the Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) for send. 'Conversations that are within the Requests folder that have not been active for 30 days will not be returned'. `since`/`channel` are not sent; cursor paging, so `page` is ignored.

get_thread.note: GET /{conversation_id}/messages?fields=id,message,from,to,created_time (newest first). 'you can only get details about the 20 most recent messages in the conversation' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations), so limit is capped at 20.

send.note: POST /{page_id}/messages {recipient: {id: IGSID}, message: {text}} answers {recipient_id, message_id}. `to` must be the Instagram-scoped ID of a person who messaged the account (list_inbound from_id); 'Text message must be less than 1,000 characters'; 'Apps with Standard Access can only send messages to people that have a role on the app'. `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

not_offered.reply: Messages are addressed to a person: 'send a POST request to the /PAGE-ID/messages endpoint with the recipient parameter containing the Instagram-scoped ID (IGSID)' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/instagram/features/send-message); a conversation id cannot be a recipient. Use send with the IGSID (list_inbound from_id).
not_offered.mark_read: The sender-action guide (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/send-messages/sender-actions) documents mark_seen for Page-scoped IDs; the Instagram messaging pages read do not document a mark-as-read call for IGSIDs.
